betterquesting:10.desc:8:
This was supposed to be the grand, ultimate vision of Covalence Dust. By compressing an immense amount of restorative alchemical energy into a single talisman, you theoretically created an artifact that passively heals your gear. But as you watch it work, repairing... uh... exactly 1 point of durability per second... you can't help but feel incredibly underwhelmed. This is way too useless for a heavy industrialist, right?

Wait, hold on, your PDA is ringing...

<< INCOMING SECURE TRANSMISSION... >>
<< SENDER: Pan-Galactic GregTech Corporation >>

"Greetings, Chief Engineer! We heard your complaints about the agonizingly slow and limited repair protocols of standard alchemy. We are thrilled to issue a public statement: Through rigorous reverse-engineering and complex NBT data parsing, we have mastered NBT Repair Technology!

Thanks to our corporate patch, the Repair Talisman now fully comprehends and seamlessly repairs your complex Tinkers' Construct (TiC) weapons and GregTech (GT) mining tools while they sit in your inventory! No more broken hammers! Glory to the Corporation!"
